RateLimited.description: Slow down and retry after the Retry-After seconds

link_secret.description: Required only if the deployment set CASHBACK_LINK_SECRET (private mode)

token.description: The user's personal bearer token. Store it in the secure credential store and send as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

activated_rate.description: The cashback rate shown on the Rakuten activation interstitial, exactly as displayed (e.g. "Up to 1%", "2%"). NEVER the homepage advertised rate.

merchant.description: Merchant name as shown by Rakuten (e.g. "eBay", "Macy's")

notes.description: Anything worth remembering (e.g. rate mismatch flagged, guest checkout)
notes.example: Guest checkout; attribution params verified on landing page

bearerAuth.description: Per-user bearer token minted via POST /v1/link. Sent as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

info.description: Bring-your-own cashback routing for Meta's Muse AI agent. The agent arms the user's own Rakuten Rewards affiliate attribution in its browser before purchasing. This API is the trip ledger: it records every purchase where cashback attribution was armed (merchant, activated rate, order reference). Each user mints their own token via POST /v1/link; trip data is isolated per token and only token hashes are stored. IMPORTANT: this ledger is maintained by the connector. It does not reflect Rakuten's records and does not confirm that cashback was credited — crediting happens on Rakuten's side, on their schedule.
info.title: Muse Cashback Connector — Trip Ledger

delete.description: Permanently deletes ALL trip data for the authenticated token. Use when the user asks to remove their data.

post.description: Mint a personal bearer token for the current user. Call this once per user, on first setup, and store the returned token in the secure credential store. Each token's trip data is fully isolated from other users' tokens.

get.description: Returns ok:true when the connector service is running. No authentication required — use this first to verify the deployment.
Returns all trips logged under the authenticated token, newest first. Each user's data is isolated — you only ever see the current user's trips. These are the connector's own records, not Rakuten's.

post.description: Call this AFTER cashback attribution has been armed in the browser (Rakuten merchant activation completed, affiliate redirect followed, attribution markers verified on the merchant landing page) and the purchase is complete or placed. Do NOT call this if attribution was not armed. The activated_rate must be the rate shown on the activation interstitial, never the homepage advertised rate.

servers.description: Your deployed connector host (set when you deploy server.py)
